units.title: Family and introductions
units.goal: Introduce your family, ask someone's surname politely and welcome guests.

grammar.title: 也: also
grammar.pattern: Subject + 也 + Verb / Adjective
grammar.explain: 也 means 'also / too'. It always goes after the subject and before the verb — never at the start or the end of the sentence like English 'too'. 也不 / 也没 means 'not … either'.

examples.zh: 我 也 是 学生 。
我 哥哥 也 是 医生 。
examples.en: My older brother is also a doctor.

examples.zh: 我 也 不 认识 他 。

grammar.title: 两 or 二?
grammar.pattern: 两 + Measure word + Noun
grammar.explain: Before a measure word, 'two' is 两, not 二: 两个人, 两点. 二 is used when counting, in longer numbers like 十二 and 二十, and in dates.

examples.zh: 我 有 两 个 姐姐 。
他 有 两 个 孩子 。
现在 两 点 。

grammar.title: Asking a surname politely
grammar.pattern: 您 贵 姓 ？ — 我 姓 + Surname
grammar.explain: 您 is the polite form of 你, used with older people, customers and people you respect. 您贵姓 ('your honorable surname?') is the polite way to ask someone's family name. Answer with 我姓…, not 我贵姓. 姓 gives only the family name; 叫 gives the full name.

examples.zh: 您 贵 姓 ？ — 我 姓 李 。
examples.en: May I ask your surname? — My surname is Li.

examples.zh: 我 姓 王 ， 叫 王明 。
examples.en: My surname is Wang, and my name is Wang Ming.

reading.title: 我的家
reading.zh: 我姓王，叫王明。我家有五口人：爸爸、妈妈、哥哥、妹妹和我。爸爸是医生，妈妈是老师。哥哥二十八岁，他也是医生。哥哥有妻子，也有两个孩子。妹妹十六岁，是学生。我爱我的家！
reading.en: My surname is Wang and my name is Wang Ming. There are five people in my family: Dad, Mom, my older brother, my younger sister and me. Dad is a doctor and Mom is a teacher. My older brother is twenty-eight; he is a doctor too. He has a wife and two children. My younger sister is sixteen; she is a student. I love my family!

How many children does Wang Ming's older brother have?
How old is Wang Ming's younger sister?

units.title: My daily routine
units.goal: Describe your daily routine, say how long things take and whether you are busy or tired.

glosses.上班: to go to work; to start work
glosses.休息: to rest; to take a break

grammar.title: 要: want to / going to
grammar.pattern: Subject + 要 + Verb
grammar.explain: 要 before a verb means 'want to' (stronger than 想), or 'need to / be going to'. To say you don't want to, use 不想; 不要 usually means 'don't!'.

examples.zh: 我 明天 要 上班 。
你 要 喝 茶 吗 ？
我 要 去 北京 。

grammar.title: 每…都: every
grammar.pattern: 每 + (Measure word) + Noun + 都 + Verb
grammar.explain: 每 means 'every'. It is usually followed by 都 before the verb. 每天 ('every day') needs no measure word, but most nouns do: 每个人, 每个星期.

examples.zh: 我 每天 都 七 点 起床 。
examples.en: I get up at seven every day.

examples.zh: 每 个 人 都 很 忙 。

grammar.title: 就 and 才: early or late
grammar.pattern: Time + 就 + Verb + 了　/　Time + 才 + Verb
grammar.explain: 就 after a time word shows that something happens early or quickly, and the sentence often ends in 了. 才 shows that it happens late — later than expected — and is not used with 了.

examples.zh: 他 六 点 就 起床 了 。
examples.en: He was up as early as six.

examples.zh: 他 十 点 才 起床 。
examples.en: He didn't get up until ten.

reading.title: 我的一天
reading.zh: 我每天早上六点起床，七点吃饭，八点上班。我是医生，在医院工作。我每天工作九个小时，很忙，也很累。晚上七点我回家，看一个小时电视，十一点就睡觉了。星期六和星期日我不上班，在家休息。
reading.en: I get up at six every morning, eat at seven and start work at eight. I'm a doctor and work at a hospital. I work nine hours a day; I'm very busy and also very tired. I come home at seven in the evening, watch TV for an hour, and I'm in bed by eleven. On Saturdays and Sundays I don't work; I rest at home.

questions.q: What is the writer's job?
What does the writer do in the evening?
When does the writer rest at home?

units.title: Shopping for clothes
units.goal: Buy clothes, talk about colors and prices, bargain and ask for permission.

grammar.title: 可以: may / can
grammar.pattern: Subject + 可以 + Verb (+ 吗)
grammar.explain: 可以 asks for or gives permission: 'may I…?', 'you can…'. A short 'yes' answer is just 可以.

examples.zh: 我 可以 看看 吗 ？
可以 ， 你 看 吧 。
你 可以 坐 这里 。

grammar.title: 吧: suggestions and checking
grammar.pattern: Sentence + 吧
grammar.explain: 吧 at the end of a sentence makes it softer. It can make a suggestion ('let's…'), a gentle request, or check something you think is true ('…, right?').

examples.zh: 我们 去 商店 吧 。
你 穿 这 件 吧 。
这 件 很 贵 吧 ？

grammar.title: 件, 张 and "the red one"
grammar.pattern: 这 件 + Noun　/　Adjective + 的
grammar.explain: 件 is the measure word for clothes (and for matters); 张 is for flat things such as tables, tickets and paper. An adjective + 的 can stand for the thing itself: 红的 'the red one'.

reading.title: 买衣服
reading.zh: 今天是星期六，我和妈妈去商店买衣服。商店里有很多新衣服，有红的、白的，也有黑的。我很喜欢一件红的，八百块，太贵了。妈妈说：“你看看这件白的吧，很便宜，两百块。”我穿了一下，很漂亮。我们买了那件白的。
reading.en: Today is Saturday. Mom and I went to the shops to buy clothes. The shop had lots of new clothes — red ones, white ones and black ones too. I really liked a red one, but it was 800 kuai — too expensive. Mom said, "Have a look at this white one. It's cheap — two hundred kuai." I tried it on and it looked great. We bought the white one.

questions.q: What day is it?
How much is the red one?
Which one do they buy?

units.title: At a restaurant
units.goal: Order food and drinks, offer choices, and say what you like best.

grammar.title: 还是 or 或者?
grammar.pattern: A 还是 B ？　/　A 或者 B
grammar.explain: Chinese has two words for 'or'. In a question that offers a choice, use 还是: 茶还是咖啡？ In a statement, use 或者: 茶或者咖啡都可以 'tea or coffee, either is fine'.

examples.zh: 你 喝 茶 还是 喝 咖啡 ？
examples.en: Would you like tea or coffee?

examples.zh: 你 要 鱼 还是 羊肉 ？
examples.en: Would you like fish or lamb?

examples.zh: 茶 或者 咖啡 都 可以 。
examples.en: Tea or coffee — either is fine.

grammar.title: 给: give / for someone
grammar.pattern: 给 + Person + Thing　/　给 + Person + Verb
grammar.explain: As a verb, 给 means 'give': first the person, then the thing. Before another verb, 给 + person means 'for someone': 他给我买了… 'he bought … for me'.

examples.zh: 请 给 我 一 杯 咖啡 。
他 给 我 买 了 一 个 西瓜 。
妈妈 给 我 做 饭 。

grammar.title: Verb + 完: finish doing
grammar.pattern: Verb + 完 + (Object) + 了　/　没 + Verb + 完
grammar.explain: 完 after a verb shows that the action is finished: 吃完 'finish eating'. Use 没 (often with 还 'still') to say it is not finished yet.

examples.zh: 我 吃 完 了 。
你 喝 完 咖啡 了 吗 ？
我 还 没 吃 完 。

reading.title: 我们的饭馆
reading.zh: 我和朋友最喜欢去学校后面的一家饭馆。那里的菜很好吃，也很便宜。我最喜欢那里的鱼，我朋友最喜欢羊肉。吃完饭，我们还一起喝一杯咖啡。那里的服务员都很好。我们每个星期都去那里吃饭。
reading.en: My friend and I love going to a restaurant behind our school. The food there is delicious and cheap too. I like their fish best, and my friend likes the lamb best. After eating, we have a coffee together. The waiters there are all very nice. We go there to eat every week.

questions.q: Where is the restaurant?
What does the writer like best there?
What do they do after eating?

units.title: Asking for directions
units.goal: Ask and give directions, and say how far places are from each other.

glosses.出: to go out; to come out

grammar.title: 离: how far from
grammar.pattern: A + 离 + B + 远 / 近
grammar.explain: 离 tells you the distance between two places. Put the place you're talking about first, then 离 + the other place, then 远 (far) or 近 (near).

examples.zh: 学校 离 我 家 很 近 。
examples.en: The school is close to my home.

examples.zh: 火车站 离 这里 远 吗 ？
examples.en: Is the train station far from here?

grammar.title: 从…到…: from … to …
grammar.pattern: 从 + A + 到 + B
grammar.explain: 从 means 'from' and 到 means 'to'. Together they mark a starting point and an end point, in space or in time. 到 can also be a verb: 'to arrive'.

examples.zh: 从 我 家 到 学校 很 近 。
examples.en: It's not far from my home to school.

examples.zh: 我 从 九 点 到 五 点 上班 。
examples.en: I work from nine to five.

grammar.title: Directions: 向 and 进来 / 出去
grammar.pattern: 向 + Direction + 走　/　Verb + 来 / 去
grammar.explain: 向 + a direction tells someone which way to go: 向左边走 'go left'. 来 and 去 after a verb show direction: 来 is towards the speaker, 去 is away. 进来 'come in', 出去 'go out'.

lines.en: Thanks!

lines.zh: 不客气 。
lines.en: You're welcome.

questions.q: How far is the hospital on foot?
Where is the hospital?
options: To the right of the shop

reading.title: 我的学校
reading.zh: 我家离学校很近，我每天走路去学校，十分钟就到了。学校左边有一个商店，右边有一家饭馆，学校后面是医院。我的同学大卫家离学校很远，他每天坐出租车来学校。
reading.en: My home is very close to school. I walk to school every day and I'm there in ten minutes. To the left of the school there's a shop, to the right there's a restaurant, and behind the school is the hospital. My classmate David lives far from school; he takes a taxi to school every day.

questions.q: How does the writer get to school?
What is to the right of the school?
How does David get to school?

units.title: Travel experiences
units.goal: Talk about trips, transport and tickets, and say what you have or have never done.

glosses.旅游: to travel; to go on a trip

grammar.title: 过: have ever done
grammar.pattern: Subject + Verb + 过 + Object　/　没 + Verb + 过
grammar.explain: 过 right after a verb says that you have had this experience at some time in the past: 我去过北京 'I've been to Beijing'. The negative is 没 + verb + 过: 'have never…'.

examples.zh: 你 去 过 北京 吗 ？
examples.en: Have you ever been to Beijing?

examples.zh: 我 没 坐 过 船 。
examples.en: I've never been on a boat.

examples.zh: 我 吃 过 羊肉 。

grammar.title: How many times: 次 and 第一次
grammar.pattern: Verb + (过) + Number + 次　/　第一 次 + Verb
grammar.explain: 次 counts how many times something happens; it comes after the verb. 第一次 means 'the first time' and comes before the verb.

examples.zh: 我 去 过 两 次 。
这 是 我 第一 次 坐 飞机 。
examples.en: This is my first time on a plane.

examples.zh: 我 一 个 月 回 一 次 家 。
examples.en: I go home once a month.

grammar.title: 已经…了: already
grammar.pattern: Subject + 已经 + Verb + (Object) + 了
grammar.explain: 已经 means 'already' and goes before the verb. The sentence usually ends with 了.

examples.zh: 我 已经 买 票 了 。
飞机 已经 到 了 。
他 已经 走 了 。

sentences.zh: 你 去 过 北京 吗 ？
sentences.en: Have you ever been to Beijing?

sentences.zh: 我 去 过 两 次 。
我 没 坐 过 船 。
sentences.en: I've never been on a boat.

sentences.zh: 去年 我 去 中国 旅游 了 。
sentences.en: Last year I went on a trip to China.
alt: 我 去年 去 中国 旅游 了 。

sentences.zh: 去年 我 去 过 一 次 中国 。
sentences.en: I went to China once last year.
alt: 我 去年 去 过 一 次 中国 。

sentences.zh: 这 是 我 第一 次 坐 飞机 。
sentences.en: This is my first time on a plane.

sentences.zh: 我 已经 买 票 了 。
两 张 票 多少 钱 ？
飞机 已经 到 了 。
机场 离 这里 远 吗 ？
sentences.en: Is the airport far from here?

sentences.zh: 我们 坐 公共汽车 去 机场 吧 。
sentences.en: Let's take the bus to the airport.

sentences.zh: 坐 出租车 去 机场 很 快 。
sentences.en: Taking a taxi to the airport is fast.

sentences.zh: 公共汽车 太 慢 了 。
请 开 慢 一点 ！
我 每天 骑 自行车 上班 。
sentences.en: I ride my bike to work every day.
alt: 每天 我 骑 自行车 上班 。

sentences.zh: 你 几 号 去 旅游 ？
sentences.en: What date are you going on your trip?

sentences.zh: 我 七 月 十五 号 去 。
你 准备 好 了 吗 ？
我 准备 去 北京 旅游 。
sentences.en: I'm planning a trip to Beijing.

lines.zh: 你 去 过 北京 吗 ？
lines.en: Have you ever been to Beijing?

lines.zh: 没 去 过 。 我 准备 七 月 去 。
lines.en: No, never. I'm planning to go in July.

lines.zh: 你 买 票 了 吗 ？
lines.en: Have you bought a ticket?

lines.zh: 已经 买 了 ， 七 月 八 号 的 飞机 。
lines.en: Yes, already — a flight on July 8th.

lines.zh: 太 好 了 ！ 我 去年 去 过 一 次 ， 北京 很 漂亮 。
lines.en: Great! I went once last year. Beijing's beautiful.

lines.zh: 从 机场 到 我 朋友 家 ， 坐 公共汽车 还是 坐 出租车 ？
lines.en: From the airport to my friend's place — should I take the bus or a taxi?

lines.zh: 坐 出租车 吧 ， 很 快 。
lines.en: Take a taxi — it's fast.

questions.q: Has B been to Beijing before?
When is B's flight?
What does A suggest?

reading.title: 去中国旅游
reading.zh: 去年八月，我和爸爸妈妈去中国旅游。这是我第一次去北京，我很高兴。我们在北京住了一个星期，每天都坐公共汽车出去。北京很大，人很多，菜也很好吃。我们还坐了一次船。我已经去过两次中国了，我还想再去一次。
reading.en: Last August I went on a trip to China with my mom and dad. It was my first time in Beijing and I was very happy. We stayed in Beijing for a week and went out by bus every day. Beijing is big, there are lots of people, and the food is delicious too. We also took a boat trip once. I've been to China twice now, and I'd like to go again.

questions.q: When did the writer go to China?
How did they get around in Beijing?
How many times has the writer been to China?

units.title: Health and exercise
units.goal: Say how you feel, give reasons with 因为…所以, and give simple health advice.

glosses.生病: to get sick; to be ill

grammar.title: Giving reasons: 因为…所以…
grammar.pattern: 因为 + Reason ， 所以 + Result
grammar.explain: 因为 means 'because' and 所以 means 'so'. Chinese often uses both in the same sentence, which English never does. You can also use just one of them. Ask 'why' with 为什么.

examples.zh: 你 为什么 没 来 ？
因为 我 生病 了 ， 所以 没 去 上班 。
examples.en: I was ill, so I didn't go to work.

examples.zh: 因为 下雨 了 ， 所以 我们 没 去 跑步 。
examples.en: Because it rained, we didn't go running.

grammar.title: 别: don't
grammar.pattern: 别 + Verb (+ 了)
grammar.explain: 别 before a verb means 'don't' — a friendly, everyday way to tell someone not to do something. 别…了 means 'stop doing …'.

examples.zh: 别 看 电视 了 。
你 别 喝 咖啡 。
别 走 ！

grammar.title: 让: make / let someone do
grammar.pattern: A + 让 + B + Verb
grammar.explain: 让 means 'let', 'make' or 'tell' someone to do something. The person comes right after 让, then the action.

examples.zh: 医生 让 我 多 休息 。
examples.en: The doctor told me to rest more.

examples.zh: 妈妈 不 让 我 喝 咖啡 。
examples.en: Mom doesn't let me drink coffee.

sentences.zh: 你 身体 怎么样 ？
我 生病 了 。
你 为什么 没 来 上班 ？
sentences.en: Why didn't you come to work?

sentences.zh: 因为 我 生病 了 ， 所以 没 去 。
sentences.en: I was sick, so I didn't go.

sentences.zh: 因为 下雨 ， 所以 我 没 去 跑步 。
sentences.en: It was raining, so I didn't go running.

sentences.zh: 他 为什么 去 医院 ？
sentences.en: Why is he going to the hospital?

sentences.zh: 医生 让 我 在 家 休息 。
sentences.en: The doctor told me to rest at home.

sentences.zh: 妈妈 让 我 多 喝 水 。
sentences.en: Mom told me to drink lots of water.

sentences.zh: 你 要 吃 药 。
别 喝 咖啡 了 。
你 别 看 电脑 了 ， 眼睛 会 累 的 。
sentences.en: Stop looking at the computer — your eyes will get tired.

sentences.zh: 我 每天 早上 跑步 。
alt: 每天 早上 我 跑步 。

sentences.zh: 运动 对 身体 很 好 。
sentences.en: Exercise is good for your health.

sentences.zh: 我 很 喜欢 运动 。
我 觉得 很 累 。
你 觉得 怎么样 ？
他 今天 可能 不 来 。
alt: 今天 他 可能 不 来 。

sentences.zh: 我 希望 他 明天 能 来 。
sentences.en: I hope he can come tomorrow.

sentences.zh: 外面 下雨 了 ， 我们 别 去 跑步 了 。
sentences.en: It's raining outside — let's not go running.

lines.zh: 你 怎么 了 ？
lines.en: What's the matter?

lines.zh: 我 觉得 很 累 ， 眼睛 也 不 太 好 。
lines.en: I feel very tired, and my eyes are not great either.

lines.zh: 你 每天 工作 几 个 小时 ？
lines.en: How many hours do you work a day?

lines.zh: 十二 个 小时 ， 每天 都 看 电脑 。
lines.en: Twelve hours, looking at a computer every day.

lines.zh: 你 太 累 了 。 在 家 休息 两 天 吧 ， 别 看 电脑 了 。
lines.en: You're exhausted. Rest at home for two days, and stay off the computer.

lines.zh: 我 要 吃 药 吗 ？
lines.en: Do I need to take medicine?

lines.zh: 我 给 你 一些 药 。 多 喝 水 ， 多 休息 。
lines.en: I'll give you some medicine. Drink plenty of water and get lots of rest.

questions.q: How many hours does Wang Ming work a day?
What does the doctor tell him to do?
options: Rest at home for two days

reading.title: 李月的身体
reading.zh: 李月是老师，她每天都很忙，没有时间运动。上个星期她生病了，去医院看医生。医生说，因为她工作太多，也不运动，所以身体不太好。医生让她多休息，多喝水，每天跑步三十分钟。现在李月每天早上都去跑步，她觉得身体好多了。
reading.en: Li Yue is a teacher. She is busy every day and has no time to exercise. Last week she got sick and went to see a doctor. The doctor said that because she works too much and doesn't exercise, her health isn't very good. The doctor told her to rest more, drink more water and run for thirty minutes every day. Now Li Yue goes running every morning, and she feels much better.

questions.q: Why wasn't Li Yue healthy?
options: She worked too much and didn't exercise

questions.q: What did the doctor tell her to do?
options: Rest more and drink more water

questions.q: What does she do every morning now?

units.title: Hobbies and parties
units.goal: Talk about hobbies and sports, say how well people do things, and celebrate a birthday.

glosses.得: (links a verb to how it is done)

grammar.title: 正在: in the middle of doing
grammar.pattern: Subject + 正在 / 在 + Verb (+ 呢)
grammar.explain: 正在 (or just 在) before a verb shows that an action is happening right now. 呢 is often added at the end of the sentence. 你在做什么呢？ is the everyday 'What are you doing?'.

examples.zh: 他 正在 唱歌 。
你 在 做 什么 呢 ？
我 在 看 电视 。

grammar.title: 得: how well something is done
grammar.pattern: Verb + 得 + (很 / 非常) + Adjective
grammar.explain: 得 after a verb introduces a comment on how the action is done: 玩得很高兴 'had a great time'. If the verb has an object, say the verb + object first and then repeat the verb before 得: 他唱歌唱得很好. The negative goes after 得: 唱得不好.

examples.zh: 我们 玩 得 很 高兴 。
他 唱歌 唱 得 非常 好 。
她 写 字 写 得 很 漂亮 。

grammar.title: 虽然…但是…: although
grammar.pattern: 虽然 + A ， 但是 + B
grammar.explain: Chinese uses 虽然 ('although') and 但是 ('but') together in one sentence, where English uses only one of them. 但是 can also be used on its own.

examples.zh: 虽然 我 很 累 ， 但是 我 很 快乐 。
我 喜欢 唱歌 ， 但是 唱 得 不 好 。
examples.en: I like singing, but I'm not good at it.

sentences.zh: 你 在 做 什么 呢 ？
我 正在 看 电视 。
他 正在 打篮球 。
孩子 正在 房间 里 玩 。
sentences.en: The child is playing in the room.

sentences.zh: 你 喜欢 踢 足球 吗 ？
我 喜欢 游泳 ， 也 喜欢 跑步 。
我 非常 喜欢 游泳 。
星期六 我们 一起 去 游泳 吧 。
sentences.en: Let's go swimming together on Saturday.
alt: 我们 星期六 一起 去 游泳 吧 。

sentences.zh: 我们 去 唱歌 跳舞 吧 ！
她 唱歌 唱 得 非常 好 。
他 写 字 写 得 很 漂亮 。
我们 玩 得 非常 高兴 。
我 喜欢 唱歌 ， 但是 唱 得 不 好 。
sentences.en: I like singing, but I'm not good at it.

sentences.zh: 虽然 我 很 累 ， 但是 很 快乐 。
今天 是 我 的 生日 。
安娜 ， 生日 快乐 ！
我 送 你 一 本 书 。
他 笑 了 。
大家 都 笑 了 。

lines.zh: 喂 ， 你 在 做 什么 呢 ？
lines.en: Hi, what are you doing?

lines.zh: 我 正在 看 电视 。
lines.en: I'm watching TV.

lines.zh: 今天 是 安娜 的 生日 ， 我们 去 唱歌 吧 ！
lines.en: It's Anna's birthday today. Let's go singing!

lines.zh: 好 ！ 我 送 她 什么 呢 ？
lines.en: OK! What should I give her?

lines.zh: 她 喜欢 看 书 ， 你 送 她 一 本 书 吧 。
lines.en: She likes reading — give her a book.

lines.zh: 好 ， 我们 几 点 去 ？
lines.en: OK. What time are we going?

lines.zh: 晚上 七 点 。
lines.en: Seven this evening.

questions.q: What is B doing?
Whose birthday is it?
What gift does A suggest?

reading.title: 安娜的生日
reading.zh: 星期六是安娜的生日。她请了很多朋友来她家。大家一起吃饭、唱歌、跳舞。大卫送了安娜一本书，我送了她一件红衣服。安娜唱歌唱得非常好。大卫不会跳舞，但是他也和大家一起跳舞，大家都笑了。我们玩得非常快乐。
reading.en: Saturday was Anna's birthday. She invited lots of friends to her home. Everyone ate, sang and danced together. David gave Anna a book, and I gave her a red top. Anna sings really well. David can't dance, but he danced with everyone anyway, and we all laughed. We had a wonderful time.

questions.q: When was Anna's birthday?
What did David give Anna?
Why did everyone laugh?
options: David danced although he can't dance

units.title: School and work
units.goal: Ask and answer questions in class or at work, say what is right or wrong, and ask for help.

grammar.title: 对 and 错: right and wrong
grammar.pattern: Verb + 对 / 错 + 了　/　A + 对 + B + Adjective
grammar.explain: 对 means 'right' and 错 means 'wrong'. After a verb they say whether it was done correctly: 你说对了 'you're right', 我写错了 'I wrote it wrong'. 对 also means 'to / towards': 老师对我们很好 'the teacher is good to us'.

examples.zh: 你 说 对 了 。
这 个 字 我 写 错 了 。
老师 对 我们 非常 好 。
examples.en: Our teacher is really good to us.

grammar.title: 一边…一边…: two things at once
grammar.pattern: Subject + 一边 + Verb 1 + 一边 + Verb 2
grammar.explain: Use 一边 before each of two verbs to say that someone does both at the same time.

examples.zh: 他 一边 工作 一边 学习 。
examples.en: He works and studies at the same time.

examples.zh: 别 一边 吃 饭 一边 看 电视 。
examples.en: Don't watch TV while you eat.

grammar.title: 问 and 告诉 + person + thing
grammar.pattern: 问 + Person + Question　/　告诉 + Person + Information
grammar.explain: 问 'ask' and 告诉 'tell' can be followed first by a person and then by what is asked or told. Remember: 知道 is to know a fact, 懂 is to understand, and 认识 is to know a person.

examples.zh: 我 可以 问 你 一 个 问题 吗 ？
examples.en: Can I ask you a question?

examples.zh: 他 告诉 我 一 件 事情 。
请 告诉 我 你 的 名字 。

sentences.zh: 我 可以 问 你 一 个 问题 吗 ？
sentences.en: Can I ask you a question?

sentences.zh: 这 个 问题 我 不 会 回答 。
你 知道 他 在 哪里 吗 ？
sentences.en: Do you know where he is?

sentences.zh: 我 不 知道 。
你 懂 我 的 意思 吗 ？
sentences.en: Do you understand what I mean?

sentences.zh: 这 个 字 是 什么 意思 ？
对不起 ， 我 写 错 了 。
你 说 对 了 。
他 告诉 我 明天 有 考试 。
sentences.en: He told me there is an exam tomorrow.

sentences.zh: 明天 有 汉语 考试 。
这 个 题 我 不 会 。
我们 下午 没 有 课 。
sentences.en: We don't have class this afternoon.

sentences.zh: 老师 在 教室 里 。
sentences.en: The teacher is in the classroom.

sentences.zh: 他 在 一 家 公司 工作 。
你 在 找 什么 ？
谢谢 你 的 帮助 ！
我 有 一 件 事情 想 问 你 。
sentences.en: There's something I want to ask you.

sentences.zh: 他 一边 工作 一边 学习 。
sentences.en: He works and studies at the same time.

sentences.zh: 老师 对 学生 非常 好 。
sentences.en: The teacher is very good to the students.

sentences.zh: 别 一边 吃 饭 一边 看 电视 。
sentences.en: Don't watch TV while you eat.

lines.zh: 明天 有 考试 ， 你 准备 好 了 吗 ？
lines.en: There's an exam tomorrow. Are you ready?

lines.zh: 还 没 有 。 这 个 题 我 不 懂 ， 你 能 帮助 我 吗 ？
lines.en: Not yet. I don't understand this question. Can you help me?

lines.zh: 可以 。 你 看 ， 这 个 字 你 写 错 了 。
lines.en: Sure. Look, you wrote this character wrong.

lines.zh: 是 吗 ？ 哪 个 字 ？
lines.en: Really? Which character?

lines.zh: 你 写 的 是 “ 远 ” ， 不 是 “ 近 ” 。
lines.en: You wrote 远 ('far'), not 近 ('near').

lines.zh: 我 懂 了 ！ 谢谢 你 的 帮助 ！
lines.en: I get it now! Thanks for your help!

questions.q: When is the exam?
What mistake did B make?
options: Wrote 远 instead of 近

reading.title: 我的工作和学习
reading.zh: 我叫李月，我在一家公司工作。我每天都很忙，但是我们公司的人都很好，我有问题的时候，大家都帮助我。晚上我还去学校学习汉语，一个星期上三次课。我的老师非常好，我们不懂的时候，她就再说一次。下个星期有考试，我要好好准备。
reading.en: My name is Li Yue and I work for a company. I'm busy every day, but the people at my company are all very nice — whenever I have a problem, they help me. In the evenings I also go to school to study Chinese; I have class three times a week. My teacher is great: when we don't understand, she says it again. There's an exam next week, so I need to prepare well.

questions.q: Where does Li Yue work?
How many Chinese classes does she have a week?
What is happening next week?
options: She is going on a trip

units.title: Weather and comparisons
units.goal: Compare people and things, describe the weather, and say what is about to happen.

grammar.title: Comparing with 比
grammar.pattern: A + 比 + B + Adjective　/　A + 没 有 + B + Adjective
grammar.explain: A 比 B + adjective means 'A is more … than B'. Don't put 很 before the adjective; to say 'much more', add 多了 after it. To say 'A is not as … as B', use 没有.

examples.zh: 今天 比 昨天 冷 。
哥哥 比 我 高 。
examples.en: My older brother is taller than me.

examples.zh: 我 没 有 哥哥 高 。
examples.en: I'm not as tall as my older brother.

grammar.title: 要…了: about to happen
grammar.pattern: 要 + Verb + 了
grammar.explain: 要 + verb + 了 says that something is going to happen very soon.

examples.zh: 要 下雪 了 。
飞机 要 到 了 。
examples.en: The plane is about to arrive.

examples.zh: 考试 要 开始 了 。
examples.en: The exam is about to start.

grammar.title: 着: an ongoing state
grammar.pattern: Verb + 着
grammar.explain: 着 after a verb describes a state that continues: the door is (standing) open, someone is wearing something. It can also show the way someone does another action: 坐着看报纸 'sit reading the paper'.

examples.zh: 门 开 着 。
他 穿 着 一 件 黑 衣服 。
爸爸 坐 着 看 报纸 。
examples.en: Dad is sitting reading the newspaper.

sentences.zh: 今天 比 昨天 冷 。
今天 比 昨天 热 多 了 。
sentences.en: Today is much hotter than yesterday.

sentences.zh: 哥哥 比 我 高 。
sentences.en: My older brother is taller than me.

sentences.zh: 我 没 有 哥哥 高 。
sentences.en: I'm not as tall as my older brother.

sentences.zh: 坐 飞机 比 坐 公共汽车 快 。
sentences.en: Flying is faster than taking the bus.

sentences.zh: 我 的 手机 比 你 的 新 。
sentences.en: My phone is newer than yours.

sentences.zh: 今天 阴 ， 明天 晴 。

reading.title: 下雪了
reading.zh: 昨天是晴天，今天是阴天，比昨天冷多了。下午，外面下雪了。我坐在房间里，看着外面的雪。我的狗也很高兴，它非常喜欢雪。妈妈说：“要下大雪了，你别出去。”我觉得下雪的北京非常漂亮。
reading.en: Yesterday was sunny; today is overcast and much colder than yesterday. In the afternoon it started snowing outside. I sat in my room watching the snow. My dog was happy too — it loves snow. Mom said, "It's going to snow heavily, so don't go out." I think Beijing in the snow is really beautiful.

questions.q: What was the weather like yesterday?
What did Mom tell the writer?
What does the writer think of Beijing in the snow?
